facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: It was a sunny morning at a small cottage on the edge of a quiet village. The birds were singing, and the air smelled like fresh bread. A kind young nanny named Ms. Clara walked up the stone path, carrying a small bag in one hand. She wore a soft blue dress and a gentle smile. Two children, Emma and Ben, peeked out from behind the door, their cheeks pink with shyness. "Hello," Ms. Clara said warmly, kneeling down to meet their eyes. The kind nanny came warmly to their house. Her smile felt like sunshine, and the children felt safe. Ben whispered to Emma, "She seems nice." This was the start of something warm.
